text: Week one, Layla books her first visit.
She thinks she's talking to her saloon, and she is.
But behind the message sits ServiceMarket.
ServiceMarket has run home services in Dubai since 2013.
More than 200 vetted partners, companies, work throughout it.
Think of them as the operator for the saloon work outside of the saloon.
They already handle booking and payment.
In our pilot, they they will add the insurance and the permits paperwork.
We look at two other big apps, their competitors, Urban Company and Justlife, but they send their own staff to your door.
It already sells other company services.
If Layla ever feels that an app replaced her colorist, Rogue is finished.
Her colorist is the reason she says yes at first place.
So, our test for partner was very simple.
Do they make the saloon stronger, or do they replace it?
ServiceMarket makes it stronger, and that's why we chose it.
